title: Recording: Mumbo, Tomorrow by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Tony Clark, Alan Parsons

The still-unnamed Wings continued overdubbing for their first album Wild Life on 1 September 1971.

The first song tackled during this session was the album’s opening track ‘Mumbo’. The backing track had been recorded on 26 July, and on this day lead guitar and percussion were added.

Next up was ‘Tomorrow’, another song from the 26 July session. Paul McCartney had overdubbed lead vocals on 30 July, and on this day added bass guitar and lead guitar, before he, Linda McCartney, and Denny Laine added backing vocals.

The session finished with a jam session, which was recorded and listed as ‘Untitled’ in the studio notes.
